mapper.select: SELECT cluster_id,feedback_source_id FROM t_cluster_link WHERE feedback_source_id IN #{id} AND is_active=1 ORDER BY cluster_id,feedback_source_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_cluster_link SET is_active=0,review_status=CASE WHEN review_status='PENDING' THEN 'SKIPPED' ELSE review_status END,reviewed_at=CASE WHEN review_status='PENDING' THEN NOW(3) ELSE reviewed_at END,review_reason=CASE WHEN review_status='PENDING' THEN '来源导入批次已回滚' ELSE review_reason END,decision_reason=CONCAT_WS('；',NULLIF(decision_reason,''),'来源导入批次已回滚，关联失效'),review_version=review_version+1 WHERE feedback_source_id IN #{id} AND is_active=1
mapper.select: SELECT cluster_id,feedback_source_id FROM t_cluster_link WHERE cluster_id IN #{id} AND relation_role='MAIN' AND is_active=1 ORDER BY cluster_id,feedback_source_id
